newsitem.title: PERU: Peru says current account deficit 5.8 pct of GDP. [CORRECTED 03:56 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Peru says current account deficit 5.8 pct of GDP. [CORRECTED 03:56 GMT]

text.p: (Corrects figure in the headline to 5.8 pct from 5.2 pct.)
Peruvian President Alberto Fujimori said late on Thursday the government's current account deficit stood at 5.8 percent of gross domestic product (GDP).

"The current account deficit was 8.3 percent of gross domestic product in the last quarter of 1995. Today we have reduced this deficit to 5.8 percent," Fujimori said in a speech during the opening of a Lima shopping mall.

The deficit was five percent at the end of the first quarter last year, according to Economy Minister Jorge Camet, who has said the government estimates it will fall to 4.7 percent by the end of 1998.
Fujimori said last week the government's tight fiscal discipline combined with prudent welfare and public works expenditures was the hallmark of his seven years in office.
